org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: STEM研究生人工标注, 三位审阅者独立核验, 团队共识消歧
task_type: 论文图表问答, 科学视觉推理
eval_feature: 学术表格/图形/图表, 三审阅者核验, 细粒度元数据, GPT-4答案抽取与确定性准确率
task_type_en: Paper figure QA, scientific visual reasoning
build_method_en: Manual annotation by STEM graduate students, independent review by three annotators, team-consensus adjudication
eval_feature_en: Academic tables/figures/charts, three-reviewer validation, fine-grained metadata, GPT-4 answer extraction and deterministic accuracy
intro_en: PaperQA is MathVista's paper-figure QA subset. It contains 107 scientific visual-reasoning examples sourced from figures and tables in August 2023 Hugging Face Papers, annotated by STEM graduate students and independently checked by three reviewers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MathVista paper arXiv:2310.02255 and official project. PaperQA contributes 107 examples from informative academic tables, figures, and charts in papers released on Hugging Face Papers in August 2023. STEM graduate students manually author the questions; three reviewers independently check each newly collected example, reaching 99.2% consistency across 736 new questions, with six disagreements resolved by team consensus. Records include question/answer type, language, source, category, task, grade, context, and reasoning skills. Evaluation uses response generation, GPT-4 answer extraction, normalization, and deterministic accuracy.
